text:
anya: Quick report: upgrading to @redwood-inference/sdk@1.8.0 made our Cloudflare Worker bundle jump ~155KB and now fails with "ReferenceError: process is not defined" on startup.

ben: ouch. how are you importing it?

anya: `import RI from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` in edge handler. bundle analyzer shows `index.js` at package root re-exporting cjs and a node-crypto/process shim.

carl: pattern we see a lot: root proxy uses `module.exports = require('./dist/index.cjs.js')` so ESM-aware bundlers fall back to cjs surface and can't tree-shake; node polyfills get pulled in.

anya: exact stack points at `dist/shims/process.js` then `ReferenceError: process is not defined`. CI also flagged bundle increase.

ci-bot: :warning: bundle-regression detected for /worker-sample (+155KB). artifact: https://ci.internal/artifacts/worker-1778000000.html

ben: short-term app fixes: 1) import the ESM build explicitly `import { createClient } from '@redwood-inference/sdk/dist/index.esm.js'` 2) dynamic import inside runtime path 3) pin to 1.7.x. all meh for DX.

carl: SDK fixes we should push: - add conditional exports map so `import` resolves to ESM and `require` resolves to CJS - set "sideEffects": false in package.json (with allowlist if any files truly have side-effects) - move any top-level `require('node:crypto')` into lazy callsites - ensure published tarball is minimal (no stray cjs wrappers/maps) - add esbuild/webpack/rollup bundle smoke tests against the packed tarball in CI

anya: typings caveat: some TS consumers do `import SDK from '@redwood-inference/sdk'` expecting a default. If we change exports make sure `types` points at `dist/index.d.ts` and that .d.ts supports both default and named imports so users don't enable esModuleInterop.

ben: also add a small note in README/changelog: "Edge/worker users: temporary workaround import from dist/index.esm.js until 1.8.1" to cut down on support tickets.

carl: I'll open an issue with analyzer HTML + minimal repro and propose an exports-map patch. can someone add an esbuild smoke test in release pipeline that fails if bundle contains the strings "process" or "Buffer"?

ci-bot: :white_check_mark: repro artifact attached to issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/520/artifacts

docs: I'll draft the changelog blurb and an edge troubleshooting note for devex docs.

anya: thanks — I'll PR the sample-app to use explicit ESM path as a stopgap and link the issue. please ping on the PR for review. :thumbsup:
